description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams' which extends a base filter parameters class. It appears to be used for filtering and sorting log entries related to performance tracking, specifically within the 'orangehrmPerformancePlugin' plugin and part of the Performance module's data transfer objects (DTO). It includes properties for sorting, and a tracker ID filter.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filter and sort parameters for searching performance tracker logs. It allows setting a tracker ID and defining allowed sort fields, with default sorting by 'addedDate' in descending order.

methods.name: getTrackerId
methods.description: Returns the tracker ID used as a filter criterion; can be null.

methods.name: setTrackerId
methods.description: Sets the tracker ID filter criterion; accepts null or an integer.
